verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page says it offers 2FA to protect access. It does not say which second factor is used, so TOTP authenticator-app support is implied rather than documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of TOTP authenticator-app enrollment, per-account 2FA setup and recovery-code details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect my account with two-factor authentication using a TOTP authenticator app

citations.quote: 2FA and IP allowlisting keep your code accessible only by authorized users.
2FA and IP allowlisting keep your code accessible only by authorized users. All code is encrypted in transit and at rest.
